per_item.query: I need emergency visa
per_item.answer:
The emergency visa service is for US passport holders of Indian origin and their family members who need to visit India for a genuine family emergency, such as a critical illness or death of a family member, and documentary evidence is required [1][2].

Acceptable purposes for an emergency service with documentary evidence (like a letter from the hospital or death certificate) include:
*   Medical emergency in the immediate family [1][2].
*   Unfortunate incident of loss of life [1][2].
*   Wedding of self [1][2].

Non-acceptable purposes for an emergency service include:
*   Attending a wedding of family and friends [1][2].
*   Religious purposes [1][2].
*   Family Reunion [1][2].
*   Tourism purpose [1][2].

If your occupation is "Journalist," you must apply for a journalist visa, even if your travel intent is for tourism, business, medical, conference, or employment [1][2].

Mandatory documents include:
*   Government Application Online Form – ORIGINAL (select Entry Visa) [1][2].
    *   Minor applicants must write their name or sign on the first page below the photograph [1][2].
    *   Minor applicants below 5 years may put a left thumb impression on the first page [1][2].
    *   Both parents must sign on the last page of the application [1][2].
    *   Both parents must sign on page 2 of the online application form below the minor’s signature/thumb impression [2].
*   Proof of Address – COPY [3][6]. This must match the present address on the application [3]. Acceptable documents include:
    *   State Issued ID [3].
    *   Driving license [3].
    *   Utility Bill (Water, Gas, or Electricity) – must be recent, no more than 3 months old [3][6].
    *   Valid Lease Agreement [3][6].
    *   Mortgage [3][6].
    *   Income Tax return [3][6].
    *   For College/University Students living on campus, a letter from the institution on letterhead explaining the exact address [3][6].
    *   Marriage Certificate if the address is in the spouse’s name, or birth certificate of a child for a minor applicant along with the parent’s address proof [3][6].
    *   A notarized undertaking from parents/children/relatives if residing with them, along with one of their address proofs [3][6].
    *   Hotel bill if the customer on L1/L3 is staying in a hotel for a project for the past couple of months and lacks other address proof or state ID [3][6].
    *   PO BOX numbers are NOT ACCEPTABLE [3][6].
*   Documentary Proof of Emergency – COPY [3][6].
*   Additional Particular Form (Annexure – A) – ORIGINAL & MANDATORY [3][6]. This form is mandatory for all applicants, including minors, and its absence will put the application on hold [3][6].
*   Passport – ORIGINAL AND PHOTOCOPIES (biographical pages only) [3][6]. The passport must have a minimum validity of six months and at least two blank pages [3][6].
*   Proof of Renunciation of Indian Citizenship – COPY (if applicable) [6].

Important guidelines:
*   Ensure all data entries in your application match your existing passport; if not, provide supporting documentation [4].
*   You can only apply for an ‘Entry Visa,’ not a tourist visa [4].
*   Select the correct Indian mission based on your residence in the USA and the mission’s jurisdiction [4].
*   Online applications are only accepted if filled out in the current year and within 180 days from the date of submission [4].
*   No changes can be made after online submission; if there's an error, fill a new online application form [4].
*   VFS INDIA CONSULAR APPLICATION CENTRE employees cannot edit or make changes to your online application form [4].
*   The Embassy/Consulate reserves the right to request additional documents [4].
